name: Franz Josef Glacier / Kā Roimata o Hine Hukatere Walk
region: Westland Tai Poutini National Park, West Coast
why: A short rainforest walk to a viewpoint over the Waiho valley the glacier has left behind, with the ice still visible high up the valley.
book: Free walk; DOC charges for parking at the glacier car park ($2.50 per half hour, $20 a day, cards only). The car park is 4 km from Franz Josef township on the Glacier Access Road, or walk or cycle Te Ara a Waiau.
water: Carry your own; flush toilets at the car park only.
dangers: The river has cut off the old walk up the valley to the glacier: you cannot go further than the viewpoint.
River surges from ice dams, rockfall and flash floods: never cross the barriers. People have died beyond them.
The road and track close for floods, rockfall or slips: check at the visitor centre.
turnaround: The viewpoint is the end of the walk. To get onto the ice, book a guided heli-hike in town.

points.name: Franz Josef Glacier car park
points.note: End of the Glacier Access Road above the Waiho River bed. The track winds through rainforest with glimpses of waterfalls.

points.name: Glacier valley viewpoint
points.note: A short climb to a view up the Waiho valley to the upper glacier, and of the bare rock the retreating ice left. Barriers mark the end.
